steps.sql: SELECT "t0"."companyid" AS "companyexperience__companyid", "t0"."personid" AS "companyexperience__personid", "t0"."personname" AS "companyexperience__personname", "t0"."role" AS "companyexperience__role", "t0"."confidence" AS "companyexperience__confidence", "t0"."types" AS "companyexperience__types", "t0"."created_at" AS "companyexperience__created_at", "t0"."_version" AS "companyexperience___version", "t1"."personid" AS "person__personid", "t1"."name" AS "person__name", "t1"."summary" AS "person__summary", "t1"."role" AS "person__role", "t1"."types" AS "person__types", "t1"."confidence" AS "person__confidence", "t1"."created_at" AS "person__created_at", "t1"."_version" AS "person___version" FROM "public"."companyexperience" AS "t0" JOIN "public"."person" AS "t1" ON "t0"."personid" = "t1"."personid" LIMIT 1000
